kind: context-sensitivity diagnostic; no new generic prompt intervention
scope: Four fresh authors, two settings, two repeats per setting, opening plus two social continuations each. Twelve publications and twelve requests, zero substantial sessions.
loop: Each fresh whole-story author receives complete brief/persona and returns a first opening. Root captures exact first final, then sends each frozen social submission to the same author. One publication per request; no editor, selector, outline or tailored feedback.
review: Root reads complete sources and all four complete three-publication sequences, then locks scores before a fresh provenance-anonymized independent review with complete sources and player inputs. Primary comparison is the two connected dinner continuations, not openings alone. Preserve all first outputs, score disagreements, local failures and ambiguities.
success_interpretation: No automatic advancement or promotion. Retainable dinner sequences in both second-setting repeats for both reviewers while Covenant remains below4 support context dependence, not a Covenant repair. Both improve: fresh starts/route variation remain plausible. Both weak: Covenant-only explanation weakens, no model-ceiling claim. Mixed repeats: inconclusive.
selection_bar_unchanged: Two substantial different-policy sessions and held-out boundary tests with retained prose/dialogue, distinction, interests, direction and initiative still required before promoting a prompt.
unmatched_variables: source authorship and embedded portrayal guidance
limits: New Breakwater brief is an experiment-authored fixture, not an existing user-approved campaign. Setting is identifiable in fiction; labels only anonymize run provenance. Narrative/context differences are bundled, not causal isolation of any one feature. No API equivalence, latency, cache, cost or private cognition claim.
